mentions.name: Notchi
mentions.description: A tamagotchi-style virtual pet that lives in the Mac notch and emotionally reacts to Claude Code sessions, crying when the user yells at it and getting happy when praised. The pixel art sprites were drawn by hand in Aseprite.
mentions.source_excerpt: I recently launched Notchi (https://github.com/sk-ruban/notchi), a tamagotchi that lives in your Mac notch and emotionally reacts to your Claude Code sessions. It cries when you yell at it and gets happy when you praise it.
